title: Set Intersection Size At Least Two
summary: Given a 2D integer array intervals, where each interval is defined by [starti, endi], find the smallest array nums such that each interval in intervals contains at least two elements from nums.
statement: Given a 2D integer array intervals, where each interval is defined by [starti, endi], find the smallest array nums such that each interval in intervals contains at least two elements from nums.
constraints: Every inclusive interval has at least two integer points.
Choose the smallest set of integers such that each interval contains at least two chosen values.
reference_solution:
def minimum_two_point_interval_set(intervals):
    intervals=sorted(intervals,key=lambda x:(x[1],-x[0]));older=newer=-1;answer=0
    for left,right in intervals:
        if left<=older:continue
        if left>newer:answer+=2;older,newer=right-1,right
        else:answer+=1;older,newer=newer,right
    return answer

Track the two greatest chosen points; add two if neither is inside, one if only the newer is inside.

Rightmost feasible points maximize their chance of covering every later-ending interval without harming the current one.
